Leverage caps per CMHC MLI Select (residential component): new construction up to 95% LTC at 50/70/100 points; existing properties up to 85% LTV at 50 points and 95% at 70+ points. The insured loan is the lesser of this leverage cap and the loan supported by a 1.10 DCR (standard rental) — see the DSCR calculator. Estimates only.
